function.name: inventory_restock_check
function.description: Checks the inventory levels for specified items and determines if restocking is required based on minimum threshold levels. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item_ids.description: A list of unique integer identifiers for items to check in the inventory.

threshold.description: The minimum inventory level before restocking is triggered.

include_discontinued.description: Whether to include discontinued items in the restock check.

message.content: Untuk memeriksa tingkat persediaan, saya memerlukan ID unik dari barang yang ingin Anda cek. Bisakah Anda memberikan ID barang untuk ukuran L dan M? Jika tidak, mohon beri tahu saya nama atau kode produk tersebut sehingga saya dapat mencari ID-nya.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "cek apakah stok untuk ukuran L dan M sudah di bawah ambang minimum dan perlu diisi kembali?" They want to check inventory for sizes L and M. We need item IDs for those sizes. We don't have them. We can ask for clarification or assume some IDs. But we should ask for clarification.
